name: Cat Cafe
source:
Riker's jazz bar in Star Trek: The Next Generation was kind of sad. So I decided to make something less sad that I thought would be a better use of the holodeck's power. 

As someone who loves cats but suffers from a cat allergy, it's not really fair that I can't lay in a pile of cats without suffering from allergies. But on a starship, with filtered oxygen, and in a holodeck, with cats made of binary, dreams really can come true.

Take some time to befriend some cats at a cat café.  Is there a better way to spend your time?

[from [url=https://darcy606.itch.io/cat-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《星际迷航：下一代》中莱克的爵士酒吧有点悲伤。所以我决定制作一些不那么悲伤的东西，我认为这可以更好地利用全息甲板的力量。

作为一个爱猫却患有猫过敏的人，我不能躺在一堆猫身上而不遭受过敏，这是不公平的。但在星际飞船上，在过滤氧气的情况下，在全息甲板上，在由双星组成的猫的陪伴下，梦想真的可以成真。

花一些时间在猫咖啡馆与一些猫交朋友。有更好的方式来度过你的时间吗？

[来自[url=https://darcy606.itch.io/cat-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
